title: Do Encoders Suffice? A Systematic Comparison of Encoder and Decoder Safety Judges for LLM Adversarial Evaluation
reasoning: The paper is a technical performance benchmark of safety classifiers (encoder vs decoder architectures) used for detecting harmful LLM responses and adversarial attacks. It focuses on classification metrics (F1, precision, recall), latency, and cost, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
